name: art-project
description: Claude Code plugin: a pre-studio articulation scaffold for practice-based artistic research. One skill (art-ideation) with six modes (socratic / provoke / lineage / brief / rehearsal / full-as-project-file). NOT an ideation engine — the Penny/Ingold/Borgdorff critique that artistic ideation is non-linguistic and material is accepted; the plugin scopes itself to the propositional articulation work around ideation (impulse surfacing, provocations, lineage positioning, Concept Brief drafting, self-critique rehearsal). Grounded in a tradition-tag reference layer (Boden, Geneplore, Frayling, Borgdorff, Sullivan, Eno, LeWitt, Cage, Bogart, Bauhaus, Manovich, Penny, Dunne & Raby, plus Korean/East-Asian entries), each tradition carrying an Authentic Practice Boundary. Cognitive-scaffold position (Clark & Chalmers 1998; Malafouris 2013). User asymmetry scope: for artists where propositional articulation is a bottleneck. Inherits citation-faithfulness, intent detection, and Devil's Advocate concession-threshold from art-paper v0.1.0 (forked from academic-research-skills v3.9.4.2). See docs/design/2026-05-24-art-project-v0.2-synthesis-spec.md for full design.
